book.title: Cloud Native Microservices with Docker and Kubernetes

author.name: Kiran Deshmukh
author.bio: Cloud Solutions Architect specializing in container orchestration, service meshes, and observability pipelines.

book.summary: Master enterprise-ready container patterns, declarative GitOps deployment workflows, and service mesh telemetry with real production examples.

chapter.title: Containerization Best Practices
chapter.content: Multi-stage builds, non-root user execution, and distroless base images drastically reduce container attack surfaces and build times.

chapter.title: Ingress, Services, and Service Meshes
chapter.content: Demystifying packet routing within Kubernetes clusters using Envoy sidecars, mutual TLS (mTLS), and intelligent traffic splitting for Canary deployments.
